articles.title: iPadOS 27 still needs simpler multitasking, here’s what I’d like to see
articles.summary: Last year, Apple completely reinvented multitasking on the iPad, with the introduction of windowing in iPadOS 26. At first, this meant the removal of the simpler version of multitasking, Split View and Slide Over. Those features did eventually return , but at a cost – they required you to use the clunky new windowing system. I was hoping iPadOS 27 would improve this, but it didn’t. more…

articles.title: Indie App Spotlight: ‘KeyAlarm’ turns your most important calendar events into alarms
articles.summary: Welcome to Indie App Spotlight . This is a weekly 9to5Mac series where we showcase the latest apps in the indie app world. If you’re a developer and would like your app featured, get in contact . Calendar events can often be missed, especially since they’re usually just a notification. If you’re in do not disturb or simply aren’t looking at your phone, you might not see it. With KeyAlarm , certain key calendar events can easily be turned into alarms, allowing you to always know about what’s most important. more…

articles.title: Here’s how iPhone Ultra’s form factor could compare to other Apple products
articles.summary: This month, Apple will be unveiling its first foldable iPhone – rumored to be called iPhone Ultra. It’s going to feature a 5.5-inch outer display and 7.6-inch inner display. In July, Samsung introduced the new Galaxy Z Fold 8 – and it comes with those same screen sizes. Whether or not you believe Samsung only made this phone to preempt the iPhone Ultra is a different story – but one way or another, seeing the Galaxy Z Fold 8 gives us a great early idea of what iPhone Ultra will feel like in the real world. more…

articles.title: Deals: Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra and Z Flip8 get first big price cuts, Galaxy S26 FE launches
articles.summary: The Samsung Galaxy Z8 series of foldables launched about a month ago and we’re already seeing the first big discounts for the Z Fold8 Ultra and the Z Flip8. They are still not cheap – flagship foldables never are – but the price drop is tangible. The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra is $300 off. articles.summary: Xiaomi just took the wrapping off the Smart Band 11 in China, with registrations already open on the home market. articles.title: 【AI轉型實例】玉山金打造AI智能徵信流程，7分鐘生成報告初稿，年省8.4萬人時
articles.summary:
徵信調查是風險控管的核心，玉山銀行企業放款餘額超過1兆元，每年玉山法金部門都會重新審視往來企業的信用和財務狀況。不過，傳統法金徵信作業最大痛點是，資料散亂和人工作業耗時。數百名負責徵信作業的客戶關係經理（RM），一年得要撰寫四、五千份徵信報告，每月高達4成的工時都花在蒐集資料上。
玉山銀行花了一年，自行開發了「iCatcher」與智能徵信報告工具「智捷通」等多款AI工具，將授信作業流程中動輒耗費十多小時的資料蒐集及報告初稿製作工作，縮短至分鐘級，推估一年可以節省8.4萬個人時。
